empty.title: No sessions yet
empty.body: Start a session and work through a problem with Ada. Your sessions will show up here.

noResults.title: No sessions match "{query}"
noResults.body: Try another word, or clear the search to see all your sessions.

error.title: Couldn't reach Tassel's server
error.body: Check your connection, then try again.

tokenReset.body: Tassel couldn't read this device's saved ID, so it set you up again from scratch. Earlier sessions won't show up here.

tile.hint: Drag it anywhere. The arrow keys move it to another corner, and Shift with the arrow keys resizes it.

pip.label: Your desk
pip.hint: Double-click it, or press Enter, to show your paper beside the board.

chat.title: Conversation
chat.empty: Talk to Ada, or type to her here. What you both say shows up here.

clear.paper: Cleared her marks on your paper
clear.image: Cleared her marks on your image

composer.label: Message to Ada
composer.voiceOnHint: Ada answers your messages aloud. Switch to text replies only.
composer.voiceOffHint: Ada answers your messages in text only. Switch to spoken replies.
composer.limit: Up to {max} images in a message
composer.unreadable: That image couldn't be read. Try a PNG or a JPEG.
composer.snapFailed: Couldn't snap your paper. Try again in a moment.

off.title: Camera is off
off.body: Turn it on when you want Ada to see your paper.

denied.title: Tassel can't use the camera
denied.body: Allow camera access for Tassel in System Settings, then try again. If it still doesn't work, quit and reopen Tassel.

unavailable.title: No Desk View camera found
unavailable.body: Desk View needs a recent Mac camera or an iPhone on a stand.
unavailable.useWindow: Share the Desk View window instead

lost.title: Desk View stopped
lost.body: The camera disconnected or another app is using it.

ended.title: Sharing stopped
ended.body: Share the Desk View window again when you're ready. If nothing appears, allow Screen & System Audio Recording for Tassel in System Settings.

error.title: Something went wrong with the camera
error.body: Try again. If it keeps happening, quit and reopen Tassel.

upload.failing: Ada can't see your latest work yet. Reconnecting…

debug.noOpenCv: OpenCV didn't load: using the central crop

webcam.hint: Use a webcam or a connected phone camera to show your paper.

denied.title: Camera access is blocked
denied.body: Allow desktop apps to access your camera in Windows Settings → Privacy & security → Camera, then retry.

unavailable.title: Camera unavailable
unavailable.body: Connect your camera or start your phone camera app, close other apps using it, then retry.

platform.windowsNoDeskView: Desk View isn't available on Windows. Share your screen instead.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our end. Try again in a moment.

description.label: What's on Ada's board
description.stuck: Step {n}: read {symbol}, no move from {from}: rejected

camera.label: Board camera controls
camera.downloadEmpty: Nothing on the board to download yet

connection.notConfigured: Voice tutoring is not configured on the server.
connection.unreachable: Cannot reach the voice server. Check your connection and try again.

settings.title: Audio
settings.presenterHint: Ada also plays on a second output, like room speakers. Push-to-talk turns on, because room speakers echo.
settings.noRoomOutput: Connect a different speaker to use presenter mode.
settings.sensitivityHint: Short replies like “uh-huh” never interrupt Ada, except on Instant.

device.lost: {device} was disconnected. Using the system default.
device.presenterLost: Room output was disconnected. Choose another speaker.
device.unavailable: Audio devices could not be listed. Try again.

mic.denied: Tassel can't use your microphone. You can still type to Ada.
mic.unavailable: Your microphone isn't available. It may be in use by another app.

readback.title: How I read your DFA
readback.deadState: Missing arrows go to a dead state.
readback.uncertain: ? I'm not sure about this part.
readback.srState: {state}{start, select, true {, start} other {}}{accept, select, true {, accepting} other {}}

avatar.title: Make your tutor your own
avatar.description: A little personality for your study companion.
avatar.name: Tutor name
avatar.saveError: Could not save on this device. Your changes are still here; please try again.
avatar.voiceDisabled: ElevenLabs is off. These choices are saved for later and will not generate audio.
avatar.voiceLibraryNote: Play listens to an existing public sample for up to 8 seconds. Live speech stays off.
avatar.previewUnavailable: Preview unavailable. No audio was generated.

memory.settingsDescription: Personalize your tutor and what they remember.
memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Remember learning goals, preferences, and ongoing topics. Notes update once when you leave a session. Turning memory off stops using and updating these notes, but keeps them saved. Clear memory deletes the notes.
memory.empty: Useful notes from your sessions will appear here. You can also add your own.
memory.loadError: Could not load memory. Please try again.
memory.saveError: Could not save memory. Your changes are still here.
memory.conflict: Memory changed since you opened it. Copy any edits you want to keep, then reload notes.

screen.ready: Open your assignment and share a display with Ada.
screen.drawHint: Draw on your screen · Escape to finish
screen.failed: Screen sharing needs attention. Restore Tassel and retry.

personalization.title: Your ideal tutor
personalization.description: Describe the personality, tone, energy, humor, and teaching approach you want. Only you edit this description; session memories never rewrite it. Your selected voice controls how the tutor sounds.
personalization.empty: Be calm and casual, like a patient older sister. Give one small step at a time, use gentle humor, and keep encouragement understated.
personalization.loadError: Could not load tutor style. Please try again.
personalization.saveError: Could not save tutor style. Your edits are still here.
personalization.conflict: Tutor style changed since you opened it. Copy any edits you want to keep, then reload.
